UpcomingDevCon Romania 2026 · DevOps Con4 November 202612:30–13:00 · Bucharest time

AI Changes the Delivery System and the Product Itself

I’ll be speaking in Bucharest about two connected engineering shifts: AI can generate code faster than teams can understand, review and integrate it; and AI inside a product makes runtime judgment, human authority, fallback and recovery part of the design. The talk asks how we preserve engineering rigor across both.
